programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Après avoir vu une « crotte géante » en forêt, Lulu et ses amis croient qu'un monstre, voire un dragon, rôde près du cirque en ville. Lulu et Rien-Ne-Sert, vantards, doivent le capturer, mais ils essaient surtout d'éviter le monstre tout en paraissant courageux. Plus tard, la bande découvre que Frou-Frou est triste à cause de l'automne et décide de lui redonner le sourire.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon devient superhéros avec des ressorts, aidant Bagou coincé en haut d'un arbre. En guerre contre des fourmis qui ont déplacé sa niche, il perd mais la Taupe règle le problème. Pour les vacances, Bagou s'incruste dans la caravane. Grabouillon répare un pneu crevé, sauve Pétunia et Cunégonde d'un accident de moto.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu et ses amis arrivent à l'école impatients de découvrir qui est le coupable de l'énigme racontée la veille. Mais la maîtresse a perdu la voix et ne peut pas leur répondre. Déçus, ils décident de la soigner avec des remèdes naturels. Pendant ce temps, l'arrivée d'un vaisseau extraterrestre déclenche curiosité, panique et soupçons parmi eux.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon cherche un coin d'ombre pour sa sieste, mais le soleil et d'autres surprises le dérangent. Il enquête sur un voleur de légumes au potager de Gonzague, mais les suspects ont des alibis. Gardien du précieux œuf Mimosa, il cause un accident involontaire, rendant Gonzague héros. Enfin, il prépare un petit déjeuner surprise avec des graines de cacao, au grand étonnement de Pétunia.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Un papillon en plein hiver ? Impossible ! A moins que ce soit un papillon extra-terrestre qui transforme ceux qui le touchent en papillon à leur tour. Horreur, Blaise l'a touché !Lulu et la coquetterie, ça fait deux. Mais peut-être qu'avec un peu d'entraînement...

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon échange sa niche contre le bateau de Bagou, mais regrette vite le confort du campement. Une bouteille avec un message de trésor pirate lance une course entre eux pour le trouver. Grabouillon perd le cahier de vacances de Pétunia, et Kivala l'aide à réviser. Quand Grabouillon casse l'antenne TV, lui et Bagou improvisent un spectacle pour distraire les filles.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu et ses amis trouvent une boule de cristal dans l'atelier de Brico et croient qu'elle donne au castor le pouvoir de se dédoubler. Ils veulent l'essayer. Lulu rêve que Rien-Ne-Sert et Frou-Frou sont amoureux, puis entend leur rendez-vous secret. Jalouse, elle convainc Blaise d'agir. Mais ils surprennent les deux en train de réparer une bêtise.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon se fait un tatouage au henné et croit avoir des pouvoirs magiques. Intrigués par des fusées, lui et Bagou craignent une attaque extraterrestre. Grabouillon colle son os sur un hévéa et découvre l'élasticité du caoutchouc. Enfin, partis en bateau pneumatique, ils s'échouent sur un îlot perdu dans la brume.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Ni Oui a peur d'assister à l'envol des éphémères, qui ne vivent qu'une nuit. Lulu veut faire un exposé sur les cucurbitacées, mais la maîtresse choisit Frou-Frou, qui en a moins fait. Lulu est déçue, mais décide d'aider son amie à préparer son exposé et à surmonter son trac.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Grabouillon rêve de grimper plus haut qu'un chat et s'entraîne, mais sans succès complet. Fascinés par les « attrape-rêves » de Gonzague, lui et Bagou partent les chercher malgré la peur. Réveillé par une pluie de balles de golf, Grabouillon joue contre des concurrents inattendus. Il crée aussi une montgolfière pour Zazimut, mais une tempête menace l'île.

programme.title: Lulu Vroumette
programme.desc: Lulu, la tortue intrépide, explore la nature avec ses amis : Rien-Ne-Sert, Belotte, Rebelotte, Frou-Frou, Blaise et Ni-Oui. Ensemble, ils vivent des aventures, découvrent la nature et apprennent la vie en communauté. Le vieux Hibou Qui-Sait-Tout rejoint la bande pour leur ouvrir un nouveau terrain de jeu : la lecture dans son arbre-bibliothèque.

programme.title: Grabouillon
programme.desc: Les vacances sont finies et les valises envahissent la niche de Grabouillon ! Il doit tout faire avant de partir, mais le temps presse. Il trouve une perle précieuse que tout le monde convoite. Pour la nuit des étoiles filantes, il tente de se relaxer, puis découvre un monstre sur la plage… Ou pas ?

programme.title: Marcus Level
programme.desc: Le roi des Moonsliders offre un fragment de miroir au vainqueur du concours de danse. Marcus, trac au rendez-vous, affronte Vipkrad et ses robots. Puis, pour conquérir la princesse Youpla et son fragment, Marcus est tétanisé, incapable d'agir. Gratrok prend sa place, mais sans être impressionné par Youpla… Marcus doute alors de son allié.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: On passe à la télé
programme.desc: Un producteur très influent veut transposer iCarly à la télévision. Mais Carly, Sam et Freddie sont vite décontenancés par les changements que le producteur veut opérer dans l'émission...

programme.title: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: Great White Waters
programme.desc: Des millions en cocaïne sont engloutis tandis que des requins attaquent quiconque approche du butin.

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Une nouvelle race de requins particulièrement agressifs sort de son sommeil après le dégel d'une partie profonde de l'océan.

programme.title: President Down
programme.desc: Un message secret annonce que le pacemaker de la Présidente a été compromis.

programme.title: 2025 : Armageddon
programme.desc: Une race extraterrestre militante lance une attaque sur la Terre.

programme.title: Rex, chien pompier
programme.desc: Le chien le plus choyé d'Hollywood s'égare lors d'un tournage publicitaire et devient la mascotte d'une caserne de pompiers locale.

programme.title: Marmaduke
programme.desc: Une comédie très drôle avec le plus adorable des dogues allemands. Lorsque Marmaduke (Wilson) déménage dans un nouveau quartier avec sa famille, le jeune chien gigantesque découvre rapidement qu'il n'a pas de place - littéralement !

programme.title: Dummie la Mommie et le Sphinx de Shakaba
programme.desc: Bien décidée à devenir célèbre, Dummie la momie peut compter sur l'aide de son meilleur ami et de son père. Un jour, ceux-ci apprennent l'existence d'une petite statuette en or représentant un sphinx qui a le pouvoir de transformer Dummie en être humain.

programme.title: Au Secours ! J'ai rétréci mes amis
programme.desc: Pour protéger ses objets magiques, Otto Leonhard a enseigné à Félix l'art secret du rétrécissement. Ses amis ayant failli gâcher son rendez-vous avec Mélanie, Félix les réduit instantanément à un dixième de leur taille.

programme.title: Night Shift
programme.desc: Une nuit explosive durant laquelle un vétéran chevronné de la police de Los Angeles emmène un jeune bleu en patrouille et lui montre la brutale réalité de leur métier...

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Lors d'une émission en direct, un célèbre animateur radio est pris en otage par des hommes armés déterminés à révéler un secret compromettant. Une nuit de suspense où sa carrière et sa vie sont en jeu.

programme.title: Death Kiss
programme.desc: Un justicier au passé mystérieux prend sous son aile une jeune mère et son enfant, tout en nettoyant une ville gangrénée par le crime et la peur.

programme.title: Gallow Walkers
programme.desc: Après avoir renié Dieu, un cow-boy nommé Kaos, se voit infliger une malédiction qui ramène à la vie tous ceux qu'il a tués et qu'il tuera. Très vite, une armée de victimes menée par Kansa, revient du monde des morts et se lance à sa poursuite. Afin d'équilibrer le combat, Kaos engage un jeune guerrier, Fabulos, pour se battre à ses côtés.

programme.title: Border run
programme.desc: Une reporter américaine à la recherche de son frère disparu se retrouve au cœur d'un trafic humain à la frontière du Mexique.

programme.title: De Guerre Lasse (Marseille)
programme.desc: Alex, fils d'un caïd marseillais, déserte la Légion pour retrouver Katia. À son retour, Marseille est dominée par les Corses et les gangs, menaçant sa famille.

programme.title: L'irlandais
programme.desc: Boyle, flic irlandais d'un petit village ou il ne se passe jamais rien, va devoir faire équipe avec un super agent du FBI pour mener une importante opération anti-drogue.

programme.title: La guerre de l'ombre
programme.desc: En 1980, à Belfast, Martin McGartland, 22 ans, doit choisir entre l'IRA et les services secrets britanniques. Il opte pour les Anglais malgré le danger.

programme.title: L'Hypothèse de la reine rouge
programme.desc: Vingt ans après que Sherlock Holmes a accidentellement tué la femme d'Arsène Lupin, les deux légendes se rencontrent à nouveau dans un musée, alors que le voleur s'apprête à dérober un livre énigmatique...

programme.title: La fille bionique
programme.desc: Une chercheuse a mis au point son clône androïde, afin qu'elle la remplace dans le monde extérieur pour l'affronter à sa place.

programme.title: Samedi Soir
programme.desc: Une journée. Quatre jeunes. Un drame. Une petite ville... L'ennui.

programme.title: Le dernier des céfrans
programme.desc: Rémi galère et veut que ca s'arrête. C'est décidé, il va s'engager dans l'armée. Le hic, c'est qu'il n'ose pas en parler à ses quatre meilleurs potes : Boom, Nasser, Redouane et Moussa... En plus, il parait qu'il est, à présent, le dernier des céfrans de la cité...

programme.title: Peripheria
programme.desc: Voyage au coeur d'un grand ensemble de banlieue laissé à l'abandon, Peripheria dresse le portrait d'un environnement urbain devenu sauvage : une Pompéi moderne où le vent souffle et les chiens rôdent, sur les traces de la vie humaine.

programme.title: Jamais Jamais
programme.desc: Week-end de Pâques, dans une ville de province. De permanence au commissariat, les lieutenants Françoise Ruiz et Clémentine Arpinon règlent les affaires courantes. L'ennui, de circonstance, éveille chez ces deux femmes que tout oppose une certaine envie d'en découdre. Une intervention pour tapage nocturne leur offre l'occasion de passer à l'acte.

programme.title: Fille du calvaire
programme.desc: Jérôme est tombé amoureux d'une jeune femme qu'il essaie de séduire. Jour après jour, il raconte l'évolution des opérations à son ami Patrick qui dispense ses conseils et vit par procuration les aventures de son cadet.

programme.title: Règlement de Conte
programme.desc: Mona et Hassan sont frère et soeur par alliance et ne s'entendent pas du tout. Ils sont envoyés dans un camp dirigé par le professeur de théâtre Melle Sankaré. Des les premières répétitions, une bagarre éclate entre eux. Punis, ils sont oubliés dans la foret. A leur réveil, ils ont changé de corps.

programme.title: Quelque chose brûle
programme.desc: Margot a des souvenirs, des idées noires qui la hantent et la mènent dans les montagnes de son enfance, chez son frère Adrien. Dans le froid de l'hiver le fantôme d'un frère disparu resurgit.

programme.title: La Plongeuse
programme.desc: Une plongeuse professionnelle s'entraîne intensément sous les coups de sifflets de son entraîneur. Epuisée, elle refuse de plonger une nouvelle fois et décide d'aller voir un masseur.

programme.title: De haute naissance
programme.desc: Le 12 juillet 1884, dans la demeure Modigliani, Garsin, un huissier et quatre policiers sont chargés de saisir tous les biens de la famille.

programme.title: Immobiles
programme.desc: “J'ai demandé à des gens que je ne connaissais pas, de poser totalement immobiles et de fixer l'objectif”. Des premiers clichés d'être humain au dispositif cinématographique, le film décline l'idée du portrait, à la fois arrêt du temps, représentation du vivant mais aussi expérience de la mort.

programme.title: La canne
programme.desc: Dans une salle de classe, les enfants attendent l'arrivée de leur nouvelle institutrice.

programme.title: Heurts
programme.desc: Fred, trente cinq ans, et Lisa, quarante cinq ans, s'aiment et essaient désespérément de faire un enfant. Mais en ce jour où Lisa fête son anniversaire et accuse la différence d'âge entre elle et Fred, celui-ci s'échappe pour une raison inconnue. Restée seule, Lisa va se laisser entraîner dans le tourbillon de son passé, et provoquer des heurts irrémédiables...

programme.title: Eric Rohmer et la pédagogie
programme.desc: Eric Rohmer, dans la salle de la Cinémamecque présente son court métrage « Véronique et son cancre » et sous une forme géométrique évoque les difficultés de la transmission et de la pédagogie.

programme.title: Blue
programme.desc: Une femme est éveillée la nuit. À proximité, un ensemble de décors de théâtre se niche, dévoilant deux paysages alternatifs. Sur le drap bleu de la femme, une lueur de lumière reflète et illumine son royaume d'insomnie.

programme.title: Breathing
programme.desc: Au lever du soleil, sur le toit de verre de la fondation, Aurélie Dupont interprète le solo « Ekstasis », chorégraphié par Martha Graham et ré-imaginé par Virginie Mécène. Une danse suspendue, entre ciel et mer, où la performance évolue à mesure que le jour se lève.

programme.title: Le club
programme.desc: Maryse, 75 ans, découvre l'existence du didgeridoo lors d'une activité de groupe de sa maison de retraite animée par un certain Charlie. Emoustillée par cette rencontre, elle entraîne sa copine octogénaire Fabienne dans sa quête de vibrations.

programme.title: Accouchement sonique
programme.desc: Suite à un accident, Serge tombe dans le coma. Une équipe de chercheurs va tenter de stimuler sa mémoire afin de le ramener à la conscience. Serge va alors être confronté à une sorte de rêve lucide, au cours duquel il devra finalement choisir entre la vie et la mort.

programme.title: Service de nettoyage
programme.desc: C'est le matin dans une maison très chic. Jessica, jeune femme de ménage, intervient pour nettoyer les restes de la soirée de la veille. Elle va faire connaissance avec les trois fêtards encore sur place… La rencontre va très vite déraper…

programme.title: Ordalie
programme.desc: À l'heure du thé, on sonne à la porte de M. Kaplan. Le cinquantenaire se trouve nez à nez avec un jeune homme qu'il ne connaît pas, une visite qu'il n'attendait plus.

programme.title: Mort ou fisc
programme.desc: André Boulet, chef d'entreprise dans le secteur de la démolition, souffre d'une grave maladie hallucinatoire. Apprenant que son entreprise va subir un contrôle fiscal, il est pris de panique et décide d'éliminer l'argent du fisc en charge du dossier.

programme.title: Midnight Heat
programme.desc: Un banquier amnésique se cache de la police lorsqu'il est accusé du meurtre de sa femme.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Maximum Impact
programme.desc: Une équipe d'agents russes et américains s'assemblent pour sauver la petite-fille du Secrétaire de la Défense américain. Kidnappée par un syndicat du crime asiatique, sa disparition pourrait déclencher une crise financière mondiale.

programme.title: Assaut sur Wall Street
programme.desc: Jim est un New-Yorkais ordinaire menant une vie paisible avec un emploi bien rémunéré et une famille aimante. Soudain, tout bascule lorsque l'économie s'effondre, faisant perdre à Jim tout ce qu'il avait. Rempli de colère et de rage, Jim craque et va jusqu'à l'extrême pour se venger de la vie qu'on lui a arrachée.

programme.title: Cyrano Et D'artagnan
programme.desc: Deux gascons montent à Paris, Cyrano et d'Artagnan. Le premier entre au service du Roi Louis XIII, le second, devenu Mousquetaire, sert la cause d'Anne d'Autriche. Nous sommes en 1642. Les complots se multiplient à la Cour. Les intrigues amoureuses vont aussi bon train avec deux beautés de l'époque : Ninon dee Lenclos et Marion Delorme.

programme.title: Cette Femme La
programme.desc: Le meurtre d'une suicidée n'efface pas les regrets d'une femme flic endeuillée. Tous les quatre ans, le passé la rattrape. Tous les quatre ans, cette femme-là a très peur. Peur à en crever. Car dans ses rêves commence la réalité...

programme.title: Sept Morts Sur Ordonnance
programme.desc: A dix ans d'intervalle, dans une petite ville de province, le Dr Losseray, excellent chirurgien d'origine modeste, connaît le même destin tragique que son confrère, le Dr Berg. Parce que tous deux ont refusé de faire alliance avec le clan médical dirigé par le professeur Brézé, ils sont acculés au suicide après avoir massacré leurs familles. Les Brézé peuvent ainsi conserver leur monopole en toute honorabilité.

programme.title: Our guys : outrage in Glen Ridge
programme.desc: Une détective chevronnée revient dans sa ville natale pour enquêter sur le cas choquant du viol d'une jeune fille handicapée mentale. La ville veut étouffer l'affaire et se montre hostile à l'enquête.

programme.title: (S)ex List
programme.desc: Anna Faris et Chris Evans se partagent la vedette dans cette comédie sur une femme célibataire qui essaie de trouver le véritable amour en se lançant dans une recherche hilarante pour trouver le meilleur ex-petit ami de sa vie.

programme.title: Tueurs nés
programme.desc: Animateur de reality show, Wayne Gale, s'intéresse à un couple de tueurs en série : Mallory et Mickey Knox. Il les interview dans leur pénitencier. Mais une émeute éclate et le couple de tueurs s'enfuit en prenant le présentateur comme otage...

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Becky, 13 ans, est pour le moins contrariée de devoir passer le week-end dans une cabine isolée avec son père et sa nouvelle belle-mère. Cette situation est pourtant le moindre de ses ennuis : un groupe de dangereux criminels tout juste évadés de prison prennent sa famille en otage.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: Récit d'une romance interdite et de l'évolution des conventions sociales, My Policeman suit les relations entre trois personnes — le policier Tom, l'enseignante Marion et le conservateur de musée Patrick — et leur parcours émotionnel s'étalant sur plusieurs décennies.

programme.title: La plus belle étoile de Noël
programme.desc: Un médecin rentre chez lui pour Noël, trouve son père à la retraite et envisage de rentrer chez lui pour retrouver sa famille et son amour.

programme.title: Ruby: héritage empoisonné
programme.desc: Ruby devait interviewer la fondatrice de Nathalie au Naturel, mais elle meurt dans un accident de voiture.

programme.title: L'Amour sous le citronnier
programme.desc: Licenciée, la photographe Becka tente un concours à Serenity Island. Elle y aide Josh, un fermier réticent.

programme.title: Mon amour, mon obsession
programme.desc: Après le meurtre de son fiancé, Megan refait sa vie. Mais Lloyd, son ex-collègue obsédé, est prêt à tout.

programme.title: Eve's Bayou
programme.desc: L'été bat son plein dans la campagne de la Louisiane près d'Eve's Bayou, et la famille Batiste tente de survivre aux secrets qu'elle a cachés et aux trahisons qu'elle a endurées.

programme.title: La ballade de Jack et Rose
programme.desc: Un père célibataire essaie de composer avec le passage à l'âge adulte de sa fille Rose, âgée de 16 ans. Quand Kathleen, sa nouvelle compagne, et ses deux fils emménagent chez eux, Rose s'éveille à la sexualité, avec des conséquences à la fois libératrices et dévastatrices.

programme.title: Docteur T et les femmes
programme.desc: Un gynécologue attractif (Richard Gere), pris dans les tourments d'une crise de la cinquantaine, a autant de difficultés avec sa famille qu'avec sa propre vie. Par chance, il rencontre une femme (Helen Hunt) qui pourrait bien être la solution à ses problèmes.

programme.title: Elizabethtown
programme.desc: Un événement bouleverse la vie de Drew Baylor, un designer en vogue. En route pour Elizabethtown, Drew rencontre Claire. Elle est superbe et elle a décidé de guider Drew lors du périple qui le ramènera chez lui.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Deux beaux mecs font irruption dans l'univers de Cher : un nouveau camarade d'école sexy et son ex demi-frère à l'esprit carré mais bien mignon. Elle apprend maintenant que lorsqu'il s'agit d'amour, elle est nulle.

programme.title: Le Smoking
programme.desc: Jimmy Tong, simple chauffeur de taxi devenu chauffeur personnel, enfile un smoking d'une valeur de 2 milliards de dollars appartenant à un espion et devient sans le vouloir un fringant agent secret.

programme.title: Chloe & Theo
programme.desc: Théo est Inuit, il décide de se rendre à New York afin d'ouvrir les yeux des gens aux effets négatifs du réchauffement climatique. Sur place, il rencontre une jeune femme SDF obsédée par Bruce Lee. Le drôle de duo se lie d'amitié.

programme.title: La valse des pantins
programme.desc: Un comique méconnu, pour se faire reconnaitre, enlève le présentateur d'un show télévisé et n'accepte de le libérer qu'à la condition de participer à son spectacle.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: Seuls sur Terre
programme.desc: Seul survivant de l'humanité, Del voit sa solitude troublée lorsque, Grace, fait irruption dans sa vie.

programme.title: Bad Samaritan
programme.desc: Deux voleurs découvrent un sombre secret en cambriolant une maison et doivent affronter un tueur redoutable.

programme.title: The Big Ugly
programme.desc: Les relations anglo-américaines se détériorent quand des mafieux londoniens investissent en Virginie.

programme.title: L'amour à nouveau
programme.desc: Ricky et Tara sont un couple récemment divorcé qui doit relever les défis de la coparentalité avec leur jeune fils tout en se remettant des blessures causées par l'échec de leur relation.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Un petit confiseur est furieux de découvrir qu'une grande entreprise de confiserie s'installe dans les environs. Mais tout se complique lorsqu'une romance improbable naît avec sa nouvelle concurrente.

programme.title: Quelqu'un Que J'ai Bien Connu
programme.desc: Lors d'un voyage dans sa ville natale, Ally (Alison Brie), une bourreau de travail, passe une nuit tourbillonnante avec son ex-petit ami Sean (Jay Ellis), ce qui l'amène à remettre en question tous les choix qu'elle a faits et la personne qu'elle est devenue.

programme.title: Love over distance
programme.desc: Evie a la trentaine, ambitieuse elle est prête à vivre la promotion de sa vie : un job à Rio de Janeiro ! Son petit ami a déjà fait ses valises, mais il s'avère que son patron a prévu des plans différents pour elle. Evie va être en charge d'un gros projet à Terneuzen, une petite ville de Hollande.

programme.title: Les Babysitters
programme.desc: À 17 ans, Shirley Lyner, lycéenne, pense à l'université et gère un service de baby-sitting qui fournit des call-girls adolescentes aux pères de jeunes enfants. Dans un long flashback, nous voyons ce qui l'a amenée à passer du statut de baby-sitter à celui d'organisatrice et de gérante du service. Tout commence avec Michael, le père des enfants dont elle s'occupe. Une tasse de café sur le chemin du retour, une visite nocturne dans une gare de triage, et les choses s'enchaînent. Shirley peut se montrer impitoyable, et la tension monte lorsque certains clients emmènent les filles dans un chalet à la montagne et apportent de la drogue. Puis, l'une des filles tente de se mettre à son compte. Cela peut-il bien se terminer : est-ce une tragédie en devenir ? Avons-nous tous des secrets ?

programme.title: The Other Me
programme.desc: Un architecte est atteint d'une maladie oculaire qui l'introduit dans une réalité surréaliste dans laquelle il voit les motivations des gens. Les visions devenant intolérables, il tombe amoureux d'une femme mystérieuse.

programme.title: La liberté à tout prix
programme.desc: Allemagne de l'Est, 1984 : Frank Korbach se réjouit de fréquenter l'école d'art dramatique, tandis que son meilleur ami rebelle Thomas refuse de faire son service militaire. Avec l'aventureux mais naïf Alex, Thomas projette de faire une tentative désespérée de fuite vers l'Ouest. Sachant qu'il ne les reverra peut-être jamais, Frank accompagne Thomas et Alex à la frontière. Soudain, ils sont confrontés à une unité spéciale de la Stasi, la police secrète est-allemande. Bien que les garçons parviennent à éviter la capture, l'ancienne vie de Frank a disparu à jamais - il est maintenant devenu un fugitif. Le père de Frank, Kurt Korbach, est stupéfait par cette évasion. Kurt est un major de la Stasi, à l'insu de son fils. Convaincu que Frank est innocent, il persuade ses supérieurs que lui seul peut ramener son fils. Avec le suspect colonel Frey - une bombe à retardement prête à exploser - Kurt se met en route pour retrouver les garçons en fuite.

programme.title: The Man From Toronto
programme.desc: Teddy Jackson (Kevin Hart) est un entrepreneur empoté qui n'arrive à convaincre personne de financer ses idées. En emmenant sa femme en vacances, Teddy se retrouve dans le mauvais Airbnb et est confondu avec un redoutable tueur connu sous le nom de « l'homme de Toronto ». Lorsque le véritable assassin (Woody Harrelson) arrive, les deux se rendent compte qu'ils vont devoir travailler ensemble pour échapper aux agents tenaces du FBI, aux tueurs à gages assoiffés de sang et à leur commanditaire (Ellen Barkin) qui veut récupérer son argent. THE MAN frOM TORONTO est une comédie explosive qui déborde de scènes d'action.

programme.title: Big Daddy

C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

programme.title: L'interview Qui Tue

Alors que Dave et son équipe fêtent leur 1000e épisode, ils découvrent que le dirigeant nord-coréen Kim Jong-un est un fan de leur émission, ce qui incite le producteur du spectacle Aaron Rapoport à lui proposer une interview. Cependant l'agent de la CIA Lacey propose à Dave et Aaron d'assassiner Kim pour faciliter un coup d'État. Ces derniers acceptent à contrecœur. Arrivés en Corée du Nord, ils s'apercevront que tout ne se passera pas aussi bien que prévu.

Ne sachant où aller, elle atterrit dans une association d'étudiantes menacées d'expulsion si elles ne parviennent pas à attirer de nouveaux membres. Décidée à les aider, Shelley va utiliser toutes ses ressources de pin-up pour transformer les filles en créatures de rêve et faire de Zeta Alpha Zeta une des associations les plus populaires du campus...

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E20
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E21
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the "Jewel of the East" campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E6
programme.desc: Darrin discovers that Samantha has been entertaining a guest each morning after he leaves for work. the guest is ten year old Marshall Burns. Marshall's mother is a widow, whose over-protectiveness has robbed Marshall of all his self-confidence. Darrin tells Samantha that she has no right to interfere with Mrs. Burns' upbringing of her son. Despite Marshall's belief that he is no good at anything, Samantha takes him to a Junior League ball game. Marshall has never been able to make the team. Floyd Kravitz, nephew of Gladys Kravitz, is the star player. With a little witchery on Samantha's part, Marshall becomes a triple threat. When his mother, fearful that he may be inured, forbids him to play, Marshall runs away from home. Samantha and Darrin drive Mrs. Burns to the ball field. There, Marshall, in his own right, has continued to star. How-ever, when Marshall gets into a tight spot, Darrin forbids Samantha from interfering. Marshall makes it on his own. Proud of her son, Mrs. Burns is not unhappy when Coach Gribben suggests that he visit the Burns home to give Marshall some extra coaching.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: Samantha, her friends, Bertha and Mary, and her Aunt Clara, all witches, decide to change the popular conception of witches into a more flattering image. Their opportunity arises when Darrin, an ad man, is assigned to devise a trademark for a new type of Halloween candy. Mr. Brinkman, the promoter of the candy, wants the trademark to show a traditional witch. Darrin at first agrees, but when he sees how upset Samantha becomes, he decides to present a beautiful witch. Mr. Brinkman objects, but Darrin refuses to yield. Con-sequently, he is fired. The witches decide to practice some of their pranks on Mr. Brinkman. As a topper, they transform him into an ugly old witch. Mr. Brinkman finally admits that his idea of witches is wrong. He agrees to use a glamorous witch for his trademark. Samantha wins her point, and Darrin wins back his job.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Teenager Liza Randall interviews Darrin about his career in advertising for a school newspaper. After Darrin takes Liza to the agency on Saturday, Liza's jealous boy friend, Marvin "Monster" Grogan, visits Samantha. Monster, a football star, wants to batter Darrin. Samantha, stuffing Monster with food, explains the innocence of Darrin and Lisa's relationship, although she knows Liza is more than interested in Darrin. At the office, Liza pours drinks. Liza and Darrin are doused when Darrin tries to take the drink away from her. Darrin escapes an awkward situation when boss Larry Tate arrives with two prospective clients . Meanwhile, Monster takes a romantic interest in Samantha. Darrin and Liza arrive, reeking of liquor. Darrin accuses Samantha of playing up to Monster. Samantha taunts him about Liza. However, when Monster winds up to clout Darrin, he bruises his hands on the invisible shield Samantha has created. When Liza slaps Darrin, however, Samantha lets him get the full force of the blow. Later Samantha removes her own protective shield when Darrin tries to make up.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Darrin's workload piles sky-high when Larry Tate and his wife Louise fly to Paris to cover the fashion showings- for a client. Samantha spends most of the time alone playing solitaire. She accepts Endora's invitation to fly to Paris, without a plane, of course, for lunch. In Paris, Samantha and Endora run into the Tates. Larry is surprised, phones Darrin that Samantha and her mother are in Paris with them. Samantha returns home immediately. Darrin tells Samantha their marriage is a mistake, since he has taken her away from all the high living she seems to love. Although Samantha tries to convinces Darrin that he is wrong, she angrily leaves, and returns to Paris. Larry Tate tells Darrin Samantha is lonesome for him. Darrin decides to follow her to Paris. After several unsuccessful tries, Samantha gets on Darrin's plane, and they arrive in Paris together.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Endora tells Samantha that Maurice, her father, is coming to visit. Endora warns Samantha that Maurice will be furious when he learns his daughter has married a mortal. Samantha, determined to stand up to her father, gets Darrin to stay in town on the night Maurice calls. Samantha tells Maurice that her husband is in Washington. The conversation about Darrin proceeds nicely until Maurice surmises Darrin is a mortal. Meanwhile, Darrin, who has been drinking with Larry Tate, phones Samantha and tells her he is coming home. When Darrin arrives, Maurice's fury hits its peak. Al-though Maurice admires Darrin's courage in facing up to him, he makes him disappear. Samantha, expressing her love for Darrin, pleads with Maurice to bring him back. Even Endora joins in Samantha's pleas. Although he tells them it will be extremely difficult, Maurice makes Darrin reappear. Before leaving, Maurice joins his family in a champagne toast. Im-pressed by the rare vintage, Maurice feels Darrin might be one of them after all.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E11
programme.sub-title: It Takes One To Know One
programme.desc: When Darrin starts searching for a "Miss Jasmine" for his firm's perfume account, Endora seizes the opportunity to sew doubt in Samantha's mind about her husband's loyalty. The search for a beautiful model ends when Jannine Fleur arrives. Both Larry and Darrin agree that Jannine is "Miss Jasmine." Samantha learns that Jannine is a witch whom Endora has asked to captivate Darrin. Samantha warns Jannine to keel away from Darrin. Jannine, intrigued, keeps on with her original assign-ment. Darrin uses Larry Tate as his chaperone to keep him from becoming involved with Jannine. Darrin and Larry go to Jannine's apartment to discuss details of the "Miss Jasmine" campaign. Jannine doctors the drinks. Larry falls asleep and Darrin becomes amorous. Just as Darrin starts to kiss Jannine, Samantha uses her witchcraft, and Darrin appears to Jannine as a large ugly fish. When the campaign is completed, Samantha turns the picture of "Miss Jasmine" into a caricature of Jannine.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E12
programme.desc: Larry and Louise Tate have been married for sixteen years and have no children. Louise asks Samantha to go with her to an obstetrician as tests have shown she is going to be a mother. Louise tells Samantha she is afraid to tell Larry since she believes he hates children. Larry, visiting his dentist at the medical center, sees Louise and Samantha enter the obstetrician's office. Thinking Samantha is going to have a baby, he tells Darrin, but cautions him not to say anything until Samantha tells him. In a reverie, Darrin visualizes his children as little witches. He comes to with a sinking feeling. Samantha invites the Tates to dinner. Both Larry and Darrin hover over Samantha, warning her not to exert herself. Louise is all but forgotten, but makes several unsuccessful attempts to tell Larry that he is to be a father. Finally, Samantha tells Larry. He is overjoyed. programme.title: Seasons of the Forest
programme.desc: No place on Earth is more changeable than the seasonal forest, undergoing radical transformations year after year. These adaptations to the seasons are what makes our woodlands so varied and dynamic a cycle of interwoven behaviors and practices ticking away like a Swiss watch to rejuvenate the landscape ready for the new year. To fully understand the stories of the great woodlands spend a year among the trees, watching the energetic and vibrant changes that mark the seasons of the forest.

programme.title: The Magic of the Mangroves
programme.desc: Mangroves are one of the most important habitats on Earth, vital to many of the planet's most extraordinary, wonderful and endangered species. Everything from shorebirds and sharks to monkeys and manatees rely on mangroves. And although we tend to view them as a mess of tangled roots, mosquitoes and mud, they're also crucial for safeguarding the well-being of humans. Once we start explore this unique landscape there's no doubt that we will be just as enchanted as wildlife by the magic of mangroves.

programme.title: Urban Warriors
programme.desc: As human populations grow, so does our footprint, and more of the natural world is gradually paved over, displacing animals from their natural homes.

programme.title: Wild Gangs
programme.desc: Life can be tough at times, but it gets much easier when you have friends to watch your back. Animals from across the natural world band together for all sorts of reasons. Whether it's to protect the home and family, to find food, win a mate or even go to war, it's always handy to have someone you can trust in your corner. From the classic pack of wolves stalking prey in tandem to the bullish lionfish mobs terrorising all other fish on the reef – when animals form gangs things soon get wild!

programme.title: Bucketlist South America
programme.desc: One of the biggest continents crammed with adventures and possibilities, South America should be up there on any wildlife watcher's bucket list. From record breaking rivers and longest mountain ranges to the steepest waterfalls and most massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife. Here you can find the biggest rodents, otters and parrots, with unique mammals and marine life and spectacular predators. Make sure you don't miss South America!

programme.title: Giants of Fortune
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world's biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo's dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn't even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Gironde is the largest and most powerful tidal current in Europe. When the Gironde flows into the Atlantic, it is 15 kilometers wide and in the rhythm of the tides, it brings the waters from the Pyrenees and the Massif Central into the ocean. This often pushes its waters far out into the Gironde at high tide.This creates a world of its own that has shaped everything uniquely and intensely for tens of thousands of years. The water surface of the river is so large that the evaporation has created its own microclimate, which is stable and, together with the brackish waters, has influenced flora and fauna on the right and left of the bank for a long time.

programme.title: The marvellous World of French Rivers
programme.desc: The Dordogne consists of a visible and an invisible system of flowing water. Caves and basins under the earth's surface store the excess water and return it to the river when it is dry. A perfect management of a precious resource, not invented by humans, but by the complex nature itself. The result is an ever life-giving river.

programme.title: mareTV: Jersey
programme.sub-title: Sunshine Island in the English Channel
programme.desc: Jersey: the Channel Island is one of the areas in the UK that can boast the most hours of annual sunshine. Not that Dave Cowburn cares very much. He works in the dark, cool ducts of an old bunker from the Sec-ond World War. Here, he breeds turbot, and is very successful at it, too. The "Jersey Royal", the regal potato, has been grown on the island since 1880, fertilized with seaweed from the surrounding ocean. In the third generation, Christine Hellio manages approximately 20 hectares on the coast. "The potato is our most important export commodity", she says. It is harvested by hand, as machines cannot be used on the steep fields. The price is quite regal, too: One kilogram costs 6 Euros. Hugh Gill is one of around 240 voluntary police officers on Jersey. The Honorary Police is regarded as the oldest organised police system in the world. Hugh works for them for one week every month. On the green lanes, the streets of Jersey, the speed limit is 15 miles per hour. Jersey has an immense tidal range and with up to 13 metres difference, it is the world's third largest. This is good for a rarity: the Ormer - one of the world's most expensive species of snail.

programme.title: The Provence coast
programme.desc: The Provence is famed for its endless fields of laven-der, but this lush landscape also has a beautifully mari-time touch: The Côte Bleue! Small, hidden beaches, charming harbour towns, imposing, craggy bays and a uniquely clear light that has attracted painters includ-ing Cézanne and Braque. The coast derives its name from the deep blue water and extends from Marseille to Martigues. This small town is also known as "The Ven-ice of the North", as it is shaped entirely by water: an inland lake, the sea itself, as well as a connecting canal. In the bays of the Calanques, the steeply-walled coastal inlets in the Mediterranean limestone, Lionel Franc is a cliff diver. His personal record is a hight of 36 metres! Ambi is a sculptress. This young artist's work, who moved to Marseille from Madagascar many years ago, is characterised by a dynamic momentum. As a pas-sionate pétanque player, she demonstrates this drive on the boules courts of the port city. John Pendray is Pein-tre officiel de la Marine, an official marine painter. The French state allows just 40 painters to its circle. There are no monetary rewards, but heaps of honour and a very smart uniform!

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. It can only happen in Atacama, far away from civilisation's pollution of the night sky with artificial light.

programme.title: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany are world famous, thanks to the fairy tales of the Brothers Grimm. The strange creatures that actually live there are shown in the episode Forests of the four-part series Wild Germany. A lynx out hunting, red deer stags roar to call their harems together, wild boar forage in dead leaves looking for nuts. When one considers how densely populated it is, Germany is home to a surprising number of different species. Around one third of the country is covered in forest. Forests enters a world full of magic and shows the secretive inhabitants you won't see when out for a walk. Spring in the Black Forest brings out the cherry blossom. Not long now, and the fruit used to make the famous Black Forest Gâteau will appear. A doe has deposited its fawn in the high grass under the trees. Nearby, a vixen is on the look-out for food for her cubs. She would just about be able to handle the fawn ... Life in the forest is full of drama. Humans are rarely seen, the animal adventures take place behind a thick curtain of leaves. The wildcat and the lynx have managed to reconquer some regions from which they had long disappeared. For rare animals like black stork and stag beetle, the woods offer a last refuge. The best nature film-makers in Germany spent more than five years travelling the country from the Harz mountains to the Bavarian Forest, from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, collecting material on the secret lives of forest dwellers.

programme.title: From Sardinia to Abruzzo
programme.desc: For many people, Sardinia is THE Mediterranean dream island: clichés like crystal-clear water and picturesque coastlines are reality here. Wild horses inhabit the vast unpopulated plateaux of Gesturi. In the adjacent high regions lies the kingdom of the imposing Mouflon. The curved horns of the male come in handy when battling over the females during rutting season. A breathtaking underwater world is hidden beneath the crystal clear water surrounding the island. Colourful fish, corals and sea snails live down here - as well as the basking shark! He can grow up to ten metres long, but he's completely harmless: with his huge mouth he only fishes microorganisms from the water. Sicily, off the coast at the tip of Italy's ‘boot', is the largest island in the Mediterranean. The island's most famous landmark is already visible from far-off: Etna, at 3340 metres the highest active volcano in Europe. Only 40 kilometres away another volcano looms high: Stromboli, which lies in the middle of the sea. It spews lava and fire at virtually minute intervals. From ancient times on, humans have feared the volcanoes of south Italy. Even today, there are 2500 year-old temple grounds still standing on Sicily. These days nature is re-claiming the age-old buildings – Mason bees and lizards inhabit the cracks and crevices, while lush flower meadows surround the ancient pillars. Abruzzo, lying level with Rome, is the wild heart of southern Italy. The rugged, uninhabited mountain world with its unspoilt beech forests make Abruzzo something special: this is Italy from its unfamiliar side! The inaccessible slopes are the territory of the extremely rare Apennine chamois. During rutting, the bucks engage in breakneck chases among the rocks.

programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The vast Delta of the Mississippi River is the gateway to the South of the United States. It always has been. This is where our journey begins: through Louisiana along the banks of the mighty river, to the big inland city of New Orleans, founded long ago by the French. Further inland, sugarcane plantations and the villas of their former owners stretch as far as the eye can see. To the north, we leave the river and, taking spectacular roads, we pass through the swamplands of the Mississippi, which were once impenetrable, serving as the ideal hideout for many a runaway. Bordering Texas, where the swamplands end, is the beginning of the vast cattle country. This is home to the last remaining cowboys in the United States who, still today, maintain their French cultural heritage.

programme.title: Dreams of the Settlers
programme.desc: The Great Lakes are among the most mythical landscapes of North America: endless water, endless forest. Many Native American peoples lived there later European settlers followed on the heels of the white hunters and trappers. They hunted in the forests and transported their furs and other goods across the water to the south where a small river situated at the southern tip of Lake Michigan flows onward towards the southern states. The settlement that sprung up there was called Checagou by the Indians. Much later, the settlement was to be the first skyscraper city in the world: Chicago, the megacity on the Great Lake.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers. With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon

On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. programme.title: Dharmakshetra
programme.desc: As The Great War Of Mahabharata Is Over, Kurukshetra Lies Barren In Its Great Warriors And King. The Thin Line Between Fair And Unfair, Deceit And Loyalty, Betrayal And Duty, Has Never Been Questioned. Dharmakshetra Resurfaces These Buried Questions And Allows The Legendary Characters Of This Tale An Opportunity To Tell Their Side Of The Story For The Very First Time. In A Post-Apocalyptic Trial, Held In Maharaj Chitragupta'S Court, The Seeming Villains ‘Kauravas' Are Allowed To Accuse The So Called Heroes ‘Pandavas' And Vice Versa, In An Attempt To Justify Their Actions. On A Primary Level, Dharamkshetra Attempts To Ask Some Key Questions About The Nature Of Humanity, While At The Same Time, It Puts Together The Forgotten Pieces Of The Story We Thought We Knew.

programme.title: Crime World
programme.desc: This crime thriller anthology series, hosted by Ronit Roy, explores the dark side of human nature—where extreme emotions such as greed, jealousy, lust, and obsession spiral into shocking crimes. Each episode presents a standalone, fast-paced narrative inspired by passion-driven murders and intense criminal mysteries. Through gripping dramatization and Ronit Roy's commanding narration, the series dissects the emotional triggers that push ordinary individuals toward extraordinary acts of violence. The focus goes beyond the crime itself, uncovering the psychological conflicts and fatal decisions that lead to irreversible consequences.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM GURUDWARA SRI SIS GANJ SAHIB
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: The Mercedes EQS SUV Electric Art Line Driving Video
programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: Wellbeing behind the wheel – The new Bentley Azure Range
programme.desc: To celebrate the arrival of the new Bentayga EWB, an exclusive First Edition is now available. Subject to a limited production run for the first twelve months of orders, it combines many of the most desirable options available for the car with a package of eye-catching details found only on Bentley First Editions. First Edition badging can be seen to the exterior of the car – a theme that extends inside, with badging on the veneered fascia, as well as embroidery on the seats. Unique First Edition contrast stitching and embroidery adorns the seats and, depending on the choice of veneers, handcrafted metal overlays just 0.075 mm thick can be applied to the fascia and waistrails in the front and the rear door veneer. The First Edition offers elegant and timeless design, focusing on maximum comfort and well-being. This specifically tailored specification includes a unique 22” ten-spoke directional wheel and bright lower bumper grilles. Other additional features as standard include unique quilted seats, mood lighting, a heated steering wheel, and increased driver's assistance aids. Attention to detail is clear, from the badging that identifies the car to the jewelled caps on the fuel and oil fillers.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.
